changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: feedback suppression reasons already admit COMPOSER_WITHHELD
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'chk_feedback_suppression_reason' AND conrelid = 'feedback'::regclass AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%COMPOSER_WITHHELD%'

changeSet.comment: Admit "the composer withheld this practice from the work, with a reason" as a withholding rationale.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE feedback DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS chk_feedback_suppression_reason; ALTER TABLE feedback ADD CONSTRAINT chk_feedback_suppression_reason CHECK (suppression_reason IS NULL OR suppression_reason IN ( 'VOLUME_CAPPED', 'COMPOSER_DEDUPED', 'COMPOSER_WITHHELD', 'REACTED_DISPUTED', 'REACTED_NOT_APPLICABLE', 'CONVERSATION_EXPIRED', 'ARTIFACT_GONE', 'ARTIFACT_CLOSED', 'ARTIFACT_MERGED', 'ARTIFACT_DRAFT', 'RECIPIENT_OPTED_OUT', 'EMPTY_AFTER_SANITIZE', 'INSTANCE_SILENCED', 'PRACTICE_REQUIRES_APPROVAL', 'BACKFILL_QUIET', 'WORKSPACE_DISABLED', 'APPROVAL_STALE', 'APPROVAL_NO_LONGER_ELIGIBLE', 'WORKSPACE_DELIVERY_PAUSED', 'STALE_ROLLOUT_REVISION', 'OUTSIDE_CURRENT_COVERAGE'));
